name: EPIC 201395169
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 13.7 solar radii and 1.05 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201395169 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 13.668226 (16th-84th percentiles 13.047549-14.310873), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,566 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 1.05 solar masses and 13.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,628 K at its surface.
